study type: Case-control study nested within a prospective cohort
exposure: FGR status (<5th centile at >36+6 weeks vs 20-95th centile)
outcome: Differential expression of placental-specific genes in maternal blood
finding: Measuring placental RNA in maternal blood at 26-30 weeks' gestation can identify pregnancies at risk of developing late-onset FGR, with a multimarker gene expression score demonstrating good sensitivity, specificity, and positive likelihood ratio.
birth_weight: FGR group: 2574 +/- 338 g (2nd centile); Control group: 3415 +/- 339 g (53rd centile)
